detail: Step 1 (Daily Job Report email check) found no ServiceTitan emails at all received 2026-10-06, as of 12:23 UTC. Searched sender onservicetitan.com with afterDateTime=today and afterDateTime=2026-10-06T00:00:00 (explicit ISO) -- both returned zero results. Yesterday (2026-10-05) the full batch of ~6 ServiceTitan scheduled reports, including Daily Job Report, all arrived between 12:01 and 12:08 UTC. Today, over 20 minutes past that window, nothing has arrived -- likely a delayed or failed ServiceTitan scheduled export, or a mail delivery issue. Stopping per Step 1 instructions without attempting daily_sync.js. Watchdog should re-check for the email in ~25 minutes and run the sync if it has since arrived.
